name: PDF Viewer
notes: Bundled PDF.js renderer with generic Desktop read, page/zoom actions, text extraction and actual canvas snapshots.

actions.name: setPage
actions.description: Render a page in this PDF window (one-based).

actions.name: setZoom
actions.description: Render this PDF at a scale from 0.25 to 4.

actions.name: getText
actions.description: Read text from a page of the currently opened PDF; defaults to the visible page.
